units: <cite ref="Menachot 37a:6">Men. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>מקום שמוחו … רוֹפֵס</he> (Ag. Hatt. <cite ref="T00957"><he>רוֹפֵף</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1) the place on the head where the child’s brain pulsates; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 222:1">Yalk. Ex. 222</cite> <cite ref="T00957"><he>רופף</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>, beg. <he>היתה רוֹפֶסֶת עליה</he> she stamped upon it; (<cite ref="Shabbat 62b:19">Sabb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>בועט׳</he>). Lam. R. introd. (R. Ḥan. 2) (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 25:19">Prov. XXV, 19</cite>) <he>ולמה שן רועה … ורגל רופסת וכ׳</he> and why does the feeding tooth eat us and the foot tread upon us?; a. e.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 36">Lev. R. s. 36</cite> <he>מה גפן זו … נִרְפֶּסֶת וכ׳</he> as the fruit of the vine is first trodden with the foot and then offered at kings’ tables, so Israel &c.; Midr. Sam. ch. XVI.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75">Gen. R. s. 75</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 25:26">Prov. XXV, 26</cite>) <he>כשם … להֵרָפֵס וכ׳</he> as it is impossible for a spring to be stamped out and for a well to be corrupted, so is it impossible that the righteous sink before the wicked; Yalk. ib. 130.—[Y. Erub. V, 22ᵈ top <he>מִיתַּרְפֵּס</he>, <cite ref="M01327"><he>מִתַּ׳</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="H01463"><he>חָּפַס</he></cite> a. <cite ref="I00667"><he>טָפס</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to cause to be trodden upon, to humiliate. Midr. Sam. ch. II, end (expl.
units: <cite ref="I Samuel 1:16">I Sam. I, 16</cite>) <he>אל תַּרְפִּיסֵנִי קַמָּהּ</he> do not humiliate me before her (Peninah).—V. <cite ref="T00965"><he>רָפַשׂ</he></cite>.
